limitations: Restricted to total proper open-neighbourhood conflict-free colouring of KG(n,2) for n>=5. No independent mathematical review.
scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof and reproducibility checker support the stated two-subset Kneser graph theorem. The classification of optimal star–triangle partitions is known and credited; novelty is claimed only for the proper conflict-free surcharge and witness-defect spectrum. Literature priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp proper conflict-free colouring surcharge and witness-defect spectrum of two-subset Kneser graphs
